relevant_laws.quote: The driver of any truck or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, which is following a truck, or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, shall, whenever conditions permit, leave a space of 500 feet so that an overtaking vehicle may enter and occupy such space without danger, but this shall not prevent a truck or combination of vehicles from overtaking and passing any vehicle or combination of vehicles. This subsection does not apply to any vehicle or combination of vehicles while moving on a highway on which there are two or more lanes available for traffic moving in the same direction.
relevant_laws.notes: A one-way road can have a single available lane and qualifying truck following. Conditions remain explicit: Document overtaking and passing activity and preserve the unresolved conditions-permit and without-danger qualifications.; Establish both qualifying goods-transport trucks, their widths of at least 80 inches, the driver and the following relationship.; Establish public-highway status and lane availability over time.; Establish public-highway status.; Establish qualifying subject and lead trucks, each at least 80 inches overall width, and their driver relationships.; Provide geometry and motion relevant to potential entering vehicles or combinations without declaring entry safe.; Retain spacing relative to the statutory 500 feet and physical circumstances relevant to entering vehicles or combinations.; Specify one available lane in the travel direction rather than inferring it from one-way status.; Specify one available travel lane; one-way status alone does not establish lane count.
